description: This source file implements the functionality for deleting a follower relationship in a social media or similar application. It defines a Command for initiating the delete, a validator for the command, and a handler that performs the deletion logic, including database operations and error handling.

classes.name: Delete.Command
classes.description: Represents the command to delete a follower, containing the username of the profile to unfollow.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates that the username provided in the command is not null or empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the delete follower command by locating the target user and observer in the database, removing the follower link if it exists, and returning the updated profile information.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the deletion process, including database lookups, error handling, removal, and returning the profile data.
